reviews.title: Subtitle Issue
reviews.text:
I bought NOW TV specifically to watch Game of Thrones because subtitles weren’t working properly on the other websites I had been using. I went to the trouble of paying for a subscription because I needed the subtitles to understand the dialogue, especially when characters are speaking in other languages.

Unfortunately, the subtitles on NOW TV aren’t synced correctly. When I start an episode from 00:00, the subtitles immediately begin showing lines that aren’t spoken until much later in the episode — sometimes around two minutes later, after the intro. This makes the subtitles basically unusable and completely defeats the reason I subscribed in the first place.

Really disappointing to pay for a service specifically for this feature and find that it doesn’t work properly. I hope this gets fixed!

reviews.title: Same Old
reviews.text: Only joined to see Nuremberg and it was a good quality film. Everything else I watch around 5 minutes before I switch off because I can’t find anything that’s good. A waste of money but I will learn from my mistakes. I always thought this streaming service was low quality and pretty awful. Still I wanted to see Nuremberg and it was good. I will use this service only when there’s a specific film that I know I’ll want to watch otherwise I don’t bother with it anymore. The majority of films like everywhere else are so bad you can’t watch them and you certainly can’t enjoy them, badly produced, badly acted, badly written and badly directed! I’m waiting for Toy Story 5 and I am looking forward to that at least. Does anyone else enjoy a good movie without consistent f ing? The movies are bad enough already but using bad language isn’t improving them, it’s making the content even worse!

For three weeks now you haven’t been updating the reality shows that I watch and so I made a complaint and was insulted by your live chat team when I explained I have dyslexia the live chat person disconnected the chat which prompted me to call back I requested to speak with a manger when the manage contacted me via email they decided to indicate that I wanted my subscription cancelled which isn’t true because at no point did I ever suggest that I just wanted my shows to be updated. Today I went to watch the shows and found my subscription had been cancelled which is very insulting and I want to escalate my complaint to a senior person as this is disability discrimination and just very insulting.

reviews.title: Useless and unhelpful

This company has the lowest trust pilot review I’ve ever seen! They froze my account for an unknown reason. Then tell me account don’t exist, then want credit card details from my account. But I thought my account don’t exist, I can’t join because my email address already exists so I have an account but it says it’s frozen. Customer service is only online chat, not helpful for visually impaired and people with dyslexia that cannot read and write properly like my self. So was completely unhelpful at all. So I got no help, can’t gain access to my account. After checking trust pilot and seeing that they also scam customers and keep charging accounts even after cancelling and misleading customers into fix terms when the customer thinks it’s a month on month basis. It just sounds like now tv is just a big scam and that’s why they don’t have a number to call because there are far to many complaints! 
Personally I’d avoid this company completely!

reviews.title: Sort it out.
reviews.text: On my way home from work I watched a football game on my phone until I was able to get to my tv. I do not pay the additional £6 a month on top of the already ridiculous £30+ subscription fee which being said would indicate that a multi million pound company with a huge following would be able to notice when something is being watched on two devices. I gave it the benefit of the doubt being that I turned the game off on my phone within the same 5 minutes as trying to watch on my tv (also now tv app). I’ve been sat here for nearly 20 minutes and the app still registers me watching it on my phone. Sort your app out. You take enough of our money. Trying to con us in to paying you more with this is just going to end up with many people wondering why they bother spending the money they do. Now if you’ll excuse me I have to sit in my living room watching a game on my phone that I’ve paid over £30 to do. Thanks now tv. Truly fantastic app. Money grabbing waste. Wish I could give a zero rating. Absolute joke.

reviews.title: Terrible. Please learn from Kayo TV in Australia
reviews.text:
For the price you pay just to watch F1, this really isn’t good enough. There are far better streaming provider examples out there to learn from - Kayo in Australia solved most of these issues years ago.

This morning was another frustration: I got up early, hit “start from beginning”, paused it to make a coffee, and when I came back the programme had finished so it kicked me straight back to live TV. No option to continue where I left off. Given how long it then takes for reruns to be made available on on-demand - it completely ruins the experience.

I could list plenty of other UX issues that shouldn’t be present in 2025, but the point is the same: for what this costs, it shouldn’t be this bad. The only reason I’ve stuck with NOW tv is through lack of choice. Please learn from Kayo TV in Australia and improve.
